Who we are

More than football.
A culture of excellence.

Tiger Empire is built around the belief that talent grows when it is supported by commitment, good coaching and strong character.

  • Build technical ability and game intelligence
  • Encourage discipline, respect and teamwork
  • Support player confidence and steady progress
  • Create a positive, safe training environment
🐅

Our mentality

We rise. We fight. We come back stronger.

What we do

Develop your game.
Strengthen your mindset.

Our programme details can be tailored to your actual training schedule and age groups.

Football Fundamentals

Ball control, passing, movement, finishing and the core skills players need on the pitch.

♜

Tactical Development

Positioning, decision-making, team shape and understanding different phases of the game.

✦

Character & Discipline

Respect, responsibility, teamwork, commitment and a positive attitude to improvement.

The Tiger standard
